summary: Public projects created on 18 April 2026: 4 repos.
intro: Agent plugins for development bug tracking and MQTT broker observation sit alongside a tool that tests hypotheses across three models. A planning workspace for home media setup rounds out the repositories.

projects.name: Dev Debugger Plugin
projects.description: Bug-ticket workflow for development repos. Capture bugs into the repo itself, dispatch specialist remediation agents, document fixes privately, and ship releases — all through Claude Code.

projects.name: Home Media Planner
projects.description: Planning workspace for home media setup — idea parking and specs

projects.name: Hypothesis Council
projects.description: Hypothesis-testing variant of the LLM council pattern — 3 diverse models (Sonnet, Grok, MiniMax) via OpenRouter, Sonar grounding, Typst report

projects.name: Mqtt Observability Plugin
projects.description: Observe and interact with an MQTT broker from inside Claude Code — monitor all traffic, watch a specific topic, or publish a payload. Credentials are collected once and reused across invocations.
